luminous-cana.the-wedding-at-cana-seco.a: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Wedding at Cana.
luminous-cana.the-wedding-at-cana-seco.t: This book walks children through the Second Luminous Mystery, the Wedding at Cana: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on trust in Jesus through Mary.

luminous-cana.about-this-story.painting-: Painting: Paolo Veronese, Wedding at Cana. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.
luminous-cana.about-this-story.the-gospe: The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Thursday.
luminous-cana.frequently-asked-questio.w: What is the Second Luminous Mystery?
luminous-cana.frequently-asked-questio.t: The Wedding at Cana. At a wedding in Cana, the wine ran out, and Mary told the servants: Whatsoever he shall say to you, do ye. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Thursday, and its fruit is trust in Jesus through Mary.
luminous-cana.frequently-asked-questio.h: How do you pray this decade with children?
luminous-cana.frequently-asked-questio.r: Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.
